name: 静音无骨U型接口雨刮器款
description: 无骨贴合静音净拭，雨夜视野清晰，U型接口四步快装

styleLock.direction: premium automotive wiper ecommerce with a rainy-night safety mood
styleLock.backgroundSystem: night navy #0D1B2A rainy mood for hero and scene shots; pure white #FFFFFF and cool light grey #F4F6F8 for infographic and detail shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool 6000-6500K; dramatic rim and backlight on dark rainy hero and scene shots; even high-key softbox light with soft contact shadows on white infographic shots
styleLock.surfaceSystem: wet glass and wet asphalt for scene shots; matte light-grey seamless board #F4F6F8 and matte navy panel #0D1B2A for studio shots
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #2D2D2D on light panels and pure white #FFFFFF on dark panels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and rounded rectangular info labels in the single rain-blue accent #35A6E0
styleLock.presentationRules: the wiper blade is always shown in its true long-strip silhouette with stable scale; variant rows keep one consistent hero angle; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium automotive-wiper ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of night navy #0D1B2A, pure white #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one rain-blue accent #35A6E0; cool-toned lighting, dramatic rim and backlight on dark rainy hero and scene shots, even high-key softbox light with soft contact shadows on white infographic shots; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and thin-line icons in the single rain-blue accent; clean high-end automotive product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the wiper blade always in true long-strip silhouette with stable scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 13 屏雨刮器详情长图切片提炼。已剥离：原品牌字与水印、适配车型对照表原文、95%/98% 等无据百分比、车标与儿童面部、二维码与店铺标识。尺寸寸数、寿命、静音分贝、适配车型数一律改为 {callout_n} 占位槽位；雨天/行车画面在 Negative 中明确禁用可辨识车牌、路牌地名与真人面部。
